allowed_decisions_semantics.ADAPTER: translates or delegates between two other components; owns the seam, not the capability
allowed_decisions_semantics.CANONICAL_AUTHORITY: owns the capability on the live path; the implementation convergence must keep
allowed_decisions_semantics.DORMANT: exists in the tree but has no live consumer; candidate for archival, not convergence
allowed_decisions_semantics.DUPLICATE: overlaps semantically with another live implementation of the same concern
allowed_decisions_semantics.LEGACY: superseded by a newer implementation but still present/wired
allowed_decisions_semantics.UNKNOWN: evidence does not establish a disposition; abstain, do not guess

authority_required.escalation: human (Nolan) for any disposition that changes wiring, deletes code, or grants execution authority
authority_required.note: Shadow mode: this envelope RECORDS a decision. It does not authorize one.

blast_radius.description: none while in shadow mode: no wiring changes, no code changes, no dispatch effects

causal_links: decision --compared_against--> alternate_decision (forensic vs rules vs Jev)
composition_model.nolan_pushback_2026_10_01: Record types are COMPOSABLE WITH CAUSAL LINKS, not a mandatory linear chain. Evidence often exists before the question (the probes ran before any label was asked). Deterministic software (the rules baseline) produces decisions without any probabilistic judgment. Some records (e.g. human_answer) arrive after the decision and attach backward via causal links. This envelope therefore defines record SHAPES and link TYPES; it does not define a workflow. Any future pipeline composes these shapes as needed.

criticality.description: shadow classification of dormant vs canonical code; wrong label misdirects future convergence work but changes nothing today

documentation: EXPERIMENTAL envelope for the authority-convergence shadow question. It is a PROTOTYPE record shape for attaching a typed decision, its evidence, and its (pending) probability distribution to one forensic question. It is NOT a canonical schema: do not build migrations, validators, or authorities on it, and do not treat the field list as closed. See composition_model for Nolan's pushback: shapes + causal links, never a mandatory linear chain.

evidence.summarizes: file inventory, exports, require graphs, hot-path refs, tests, gateway container, git status
class-name require graph, registry headers, stack listings, gateway /app staleness (md5 mismatch)
require() direction per target, approval require reality, typed_decision exports, shadow_worker wiring, bridge wiring
DI wiring of hot path, instantiation sites, scheduler poll loop, dynamic-require sweep
live-path verification, dormant-stack identification, worktree authority-overlap scan
closed label set, shadow-before-advisory sequence, DecisionUnit-not-JevAuthority boundary

evidence_requirements: every label must cite at least one machine fact (require graph, file header, test reference, or probe line)
require() graphs must include the dynamic require(path.join(...)) sweep, not only static string requires
DI-wired components must record the injection evidence (constructor signature, instantiation sites or their absence)
absence of evidence must be recorded as UNKNOWN or as an explicit evidence gap, never as DORMANT-by-default
experiment: authority-convergence shadow dataset, phase-2 proving slice (Track B)

novelty.description: first labelled authority-convergence dataset in this program; label semantics are new and uncalibrated

probability_distribution.note: No Jev model endpoint exists. Per the CEO order and tasking, no distribution is fabricated. The rules baseline emits hard labels only. This field becomes meaningful if/when a typed-decision provider (Jev, AnyJev, local classifier) is benchmarked against the labelled set.

question: Which authority-convergence disposition applies to <component>?

question_binding.instantiation: one DecisionUnit record per labelled example (authconv-001..014); proposed_decision may hold the deterministic-rules output as a recorded alternate, never as the decision

reversibility.description: fully reversible: records only; no state, wiring, or authority changes

warnings: NOT A CANONICAL SCHEMA. Do not constitutionalize, migrate to, or validate against this shape.
Jev (or any model) ESTIMATES; it never authorizes, executes, writes canonical truth, or approves itself. This envelope is the recording surface for that estimate, nothing more.
Do not build a fourth capability registry. Do not converge anything on the basis of shadow labels. Convergence remains governed by existing authority work.
